I notice a critical issue: the cart-service pods have different labels between the old and new deployment! The old version likely used `app: cart-service`, but the new version (4.2) uses `app.kubernetes.io/name: cart-service` and other kubernetes.io labels (Helm standard labels). However, the Service still has the old selector `app: cart-service`, so it's not routing traffic to the new pods.
